programmes.d: Lucas and Mark try to persuade a persecuted young mute to return stolen money.
A lively old lady arrives in town hot on the trail of a notorious bandit and the reward money for capturing him.
A doctor seeks revenge on the man he blames for ruining his practice.
A cattleman tries to take over the railroad so that he can control the price of shipping cattle.
When a girl is blinded in the murder of her father, Annie tries to help her identify the killer.
Sam Forbes is murdered and his foreman Choctaw looks to inherit his ranch when a previously unknown niece Elaine appears.
Jim Bowie finds himself in the middle of a dispute between American settlers and Cherokee Indians when he seeks help in driving a herd of cattle home from Texas.
When Captain Paolo is kidnapped from his hotel room, his frightened chimpanzee ends up in Bowie's room. Bowie enlists reporter Tebbs and the captain's daughter in a plan to expose the kidnappers.
Jim is tricked into aiding a plot to assassinate President Jackson.
When Jim Bowie’s brother, Rezin, takes a try at being a professional gambler, Jim sets out to frame Rezin into a big loss at the hands of some real gamblers.
A poor man steals Cisco's and Pancho's horses, trying to raise money to impress his visiting daughter. Later, he becomes the unsuspecting fall guy in a cattle rustling operation.
Cisco follows the killer of a U.S. marshal to the town of Twin Buttes, which is notorious as a haven for criminals of all kinds.
After having captured and jailed a bank robber, Pancho is then taken hostage by the robber's sister, who threatens to kill him unless Cisco frees her brother.
A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.
An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

Josh and Jason are hired to chase a killer who went to Mexico by his brother who is about to hang for a crime his brother committed.
Josh and Jason are on the trail of a karate expert accused of killing his employer.

Randall learns "hate comes high" in a town whose people have hired a trio of killers to murder their fellow resident Randy Holleran, a sniveling drunkard whom Josh can't stand but has promised his father to protect.
Josh captures a wanted recruit and returns him to the Army, but the Captain at an encampment refuses to pay the bounty as he has another use for the trooper.

A dying man offers Josh $2000 to find his son, who ran away from home 15 years ago.
Josh and Jason are escorting four prisoners - three men and one woman - to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind asking to travel with the group for protection.
Josh is summoned for help when the Pinto bank is robbed.
Josh expects a $400 bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but finds his prisoner stolen from him by the sheriff.
Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry a drunk who is also Josh's friend.
Josh and the beautiful female prisoner he is transporting to trial are on a three-day trip while her partner is still on the loose in the area.
A group of pioneers finds a wasteland on their way to California, which they aptly name Death Valley.
The California desert is taking its toll on Rosie and her husband Aaron after months of failed mining.
A young bandit is robbing banks and businesses in a sheriff's territory.
Two people set out into the desert in search of the lost Pegleg gold mine.
Mamie Jaggers is one of the only single women in the mining town of Bullfrog, Nevada.
After an accident, a hard-rock miner and champion driller is encouraged by a dance hall girl to study law.
A butterfly collector comes to Death Valley and not only finds moths but discovers his true love.
A quiet dressmaker for the dance hall girls in a Western mining camp is discovered to be Tiger Lil.
An embittered prospector is robbed of a large sum, and the life he can provide his wife changes drastically.
